pros.title: plain loin is a world away from processed pork
pros.explanation: It does not need curing, smoking, breading, or a mystery ingredient list to work.

pros.title: one roast can cover several meals
pros.explanation: Dinner first, then sandwiches, wraps, or stir-fries with the leftovers.

pros.title: the mild flavour takes seasoning really well
pros.explanation: Change the herbs, spice mix, or sauce and the same cut can go in a completely different direction.

cons.title: the safe-temperature rule matters
cons.explanation: Whole pork cuts need to reach 145 degrees Fahrenheit, then rest for at least 3 minutes.

cons.title: overcooking can dry it out fast
cons.explanation: Loin is not very forgiving once it sails past the sweet spot.

cons.title: some prepackaged options have salty water added
cons.explanation: Check the label if you want plain pork without the extra salt.
